g.title: Word order in questions
g.rule:
In a question the helping verb comes before the subject.

beAre you a student? · Where is he from?
do / does / did + verbDo you live here? · Where did she work?
question word firstWhat do you do? · How often does he play?
g.ru: В вопросе вспомогательный глагол (be, do, does, did) стоит перед подлежащим: Where do you live?

ex.q: Where ___ you live?
What ___ your sister do?
___ you married? (be)

talk: Ask and answer five questions about your family, job and free time.
What questions do you ask when you meet a new person?

g.title: Present simple
g.rule:
Use the present simple for habits and facts.

I / you / we / theyI wear jeans. · They don't wear ties.
he / she / it + -sShe wears glasses. · He doesn't like hats.
how oftenI usually get up early. · She is never late.
g.ru: Present simple — привычки и факты. С he / she / it добавляем -s: she wears; в отрицании doesn't + глагол без -s.

ex.q: My brother ___ a beard.
She ___ wear make-up.
He always ___ (get) up at seven.

talk: Describe a person in your family: what do they look like and what do they usually wear?
What do you usually do at the weekend?

g.title: Present continuous
g.rule:
Use the present continuous for something happening now or around now.

be + verb-ingI'm watching a film. · She's wearing a red coat.
negative and questionThey aren't working. · What are you doing?
habit → present simpleI watch films every Friday.
g.ru: Present continuous (be + глагол с -ing) — действие происходит сейчас или в этот период. Привычки — present simple.

ex.q: Look! It ___.
What ___ you reading at the moment?
We ___ (not / watch) TV now.

talk: Describe a photo on your phone: what are the people doing and wearing?
What series or book are you enjoying at the moment?

g.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs
g.rule:
Use the past simple for finished actions in the past.

regular: + -edWe stayed in a hotel. · I looked everywhere.
irregular: learn themgo → went · lose → lost · find → found
negative and question: did + verbI didn't find it. · Where did you leave it?
g.ru: Past simple — законченные действия в прошлом. Правильные глаголы: + -ed; неправильные нужно учить. Отрицание и вопрос: did / didn't + глагол в первой форме.

ex.q: We ___ to Almaty last summer.
I ___ my keys yesterday.
Where ___ you lose your phone?

g.title: Time sequencers and connectors
g.rule:
Use these words to put the events of a story in order and to connect ideas.

orderFirst · then · after that · next day · suddenly · in the end
reason and resultI ran because I was late. · I was late, so I ran.
contrastAlthough it was dark, we went out. · It was dark, but we went out.
g.ru: Слова для рассказа: first, then, after that, suddenly, in the end. Because — причина, so — результат, although / but — противопоставление.

ex.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
___ it was raining, we walked home.
We missed the bus ___ we got up late.

g.title: Defining relative clauses
g.rule:
A relative clause says which person, thing or place you mean.

people: who (or that)A chef is a person who cooks food.
things: which (or that)A kettle is a thing which boils water.
places: whereA library is a place where you borrow books.
g.ru: Who — о людях, which — о вещах, where — о местах. That можно использовать вместо who и which.

ex.q: A nurse is a person ___ works in a hospital.
This is the café ___ we had lunch.
It's a thing ___ you use to open a door.

talk: Play a definition game: describe five words without saying them.

g.title: Present perfect + yet, just, already
g.rule:
Use the present perfect for a past action that matters now.

have / has + past participleI've finished. · She's cleaned the kitchen.
just · already (before the participle)I've just had lunch. · He's already gone.
yet (at the end; questions and negatives)Have you done it yet? · I haven't done it yet.
g.ru: Present perfect (have / has + третья форма) — результат важен сейчас. Just и already ставятся перед причастием, yet — в конце вопроса или отрицания.

ex.q: I haven't washed the dishes ___.
She has ___ left. You can't see her.
Have you ___ (do) your homework yet?

g.title: Possessive pronouns
g.rule:
A possessive pronoun replaces a noun, so there is no noun after it.

g.title: Present perfect or past simple? (2)
g.rule:
Is the period finished or does it continue until now?

still true → present perfectShe's been an actor for ten years. (She is an actor now.)
finished → past simpleShe was a dancer for five years. (Not now.)
people who are dead → past simpleHe wrote forty songs.
g.ru: Если ситуация продолжается сейчас — present perfect; если она закончилась (или человека уже нет) — past simple.

g.title: The passive
